titulo_fr: Une nouvelle de quartier : Repérer les informations
titulo_es: A news of the neighborhood: Find data
intro: Distinguish main fact, context and consequences in a local news. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Distinguish main fact, context and consequences in a local news. It separates the fact of its context: the verbal times, connectors and powers indicate when and who provides each data.
Attention point: The composite passé presents facts; the imparfait describes the stage and the connectors link consequences. In this fragment, «chantier» means «work».

frases.fr: La ville a inauguré lundi une piste cyclable de quatre kilomètres entre la gare et le campus.
frases.es: La ciudad inauguró el lunes un carril bici de cuatro kilómetros entre la estación y el campus.
frases.en: The city opened a four-kilometre bike lane between the station and the campus on Monday.

frases.fr: Le chantier avait commencé au printemps, alors que la rue restait ouverte aux bus.
frases.es: Las obras habían empezado en primavera, mientras la calle seguía abierta a los autobuses.
frases.en: The works had started in spring, while the street was still open to buses.
